name: tinyexec-grandchild-mre
description: Reproduces the tinyexec grandchild-pipe deadlock and 1.2.3 buffer-drain regression, both directly and through lint-staged.

scripts.install:all: (cd via-tinyexec && npm install --no-fund --no-audit) && (cd via-lint-staged && npm install --no-fund --no-audit)
scripts.test: npm run test:via-tinyexec && npm run test:via-lint-staged
